# crosswork_bandwidth_on_demand (Resource)

This resource can manage the bandwidth on demand function pack of traffic engineering.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "crosswork_bandwidth_on_demand" "example" {
  enable                        = false
  primary_objective             = "MIN_METRIC"
  link_utilization_threshold    = 85
  reoptimization_interval       = 61
  metric_reoptimization_hours   = 2
  metric_reoptimization_minutes = 15
  sr_policy_traffic             = "MEASURED"
  model_update_throttle         = 5
  optimizer_event_threshold     = 50
  optimizer_run_time_limit      = 70
  allowed_policy_violations     = "STRICT"
  prefer_strict_sids            = true
  debug_optimizer               = true
  debug_optimizer_max_files     = 31
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `allowed_policy_violations` (String) How BWoD acts when new policies are provisioned and policy violations are detected
  - Choices: `LOOSE`, `STRICT`
  - Default value: `LOOSE`
- `debug_optimizer` (Boolean) Save debug plan files to the filesystem
  - Default value: `false`
- `debug_optimizer_max_files` (Number) Maximum number of debug plan file sets to save
  - Range: `1`-`512`
  - Default value: `30`
- `enable` (Boolean) Enables the bandwidth on demand function pack
  - Default value: `false`
- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.
- `link_utilization_threshold` (Number) Interfaces whose utilization percentage exceeds this threshold are optimized
  - Range: `1`-`100`
  - Default value: `80`
- `metric_reoptimization_hours` (Number) Hour of the day (0 to 23) to run the metric re-optimization on all BWoD provisioned policies
  - Range: `0`-`23`
  - Default value: `1`
- `metric_reoptimization_minutes` (Number) Minute of the hour (0 to 59) to run the metric re-optimization on all BWoD provisioned policies
  - Range: `0`-`59`
  - Default value: `30`
- `model_update_throttle` (Number) Time in seconds to wait between model updates; 0 disables the throttle
  - Range: `0`-`4294967295`
  - Default value: `0`
- `optimizer_event_threshold` (Number) If the optimizer runs longer than this number of seconds, an event is sent to the UI
  - Range: `1`-`4294967295`
  - Default value: `45`
- `optimizer_run_time_limit` (Number) Maximum run time in seconds of the BWoD optimizer
  - Range: `1`-`4294967295`
  - Default value: `60`
- `prefer_strict_sids` (Boolean) Prefer strict SIDs when deriving segment lists; required for compatibility with LCM
  - Default value: `false`
- `primary_objective` (String) Primary objective when optimizing policies
  - Choices: `MAX_AVAIL_BW`, `MIN_METRIC`
  - Default value: `MAX_AVAIL_BW`
- `reoptimization_interval` (Number) Time in seconds before policies are available to be re-optimized since the last path change
  - Range: `0`-`4294967295`
  - Default value: `60`
- `sr_policy_traffic` (String) Method to determine the bandwidth associated with each SR policy when optimization is performed
  - Choices: `MAX_MEASURED_REQUESTED`, `MEASURED`
  - Default value: `MAX_MEASURED_REQUESTED`

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import crosswork_bandwidth_on_demand.example "bandwidth_on_demand"
```
